financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: MercadoLibre reported AI-enhanced search improvements to conversion and engagement, with gross-profit benefit partly offset by third-party LLM costs; no uplift magnitude was disclosed.
ai_claim.stage: E2 named issuer-reported production search deployment; no E3/E4
ai_claim.scope: Marketplace search only; own productivity and infrastructure demand remain separate.
ai_claim.limitation: No quantified causal uplift, matched cohort, model-cost allocation or retained-cash reconciliation.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Q2 operating margin was only 6.7% despite 50% revenue growth.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: $34.15m = 5% of Q2 2026 reported operating income of $683m. This is a quarter-only, pre-tax screen and is NOT_COMPARABLE with the annual benefit illustration; no annualization is assumed.
